description: Verzeichnis der Strassen und Plätze is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Basisdaten Stadt Biel. Dieser Geodatensatz enthält alle Namen der Strassen und Plätze in der Stadt Biel auf Deutsch und Französisch (offizielle Übersetzung). Die Grundlage für den Inhalt ist die Verordnung über das Register der Strassen und Plätze in der Stadt Biel (SGR 7.3-1). Coverage: Basisdaten Stadt Biel. The portal files it under the publisher Basisdaten Stadt Biel. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTML, XLS. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
